summary: The panel is redesigned in the FutureForge Studios language. New: Simplified and Advanced view modes, reseller and client accounts with owned resources, quotas and branding, and a one-click app installer (WordPress, DokuWiki). Migrations 0008 and 0009 are additive: 0008 adds users.view_mode, users.audience and users.parent_id with defaults plus the account_limits, reseller_branding and resource_owners tables; 0009 adds the app_installs table. Nothing is dropped or rewritten.
